A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same U-ViLAR study, and all supplied text, equations, six tables and six figures are readable and matchable. Neither file contains the appendix referenced in Sections 4.1 and 4.3; judgments therefore cover the supplied material, not unseen supplementary content.

before.justification: v1 reports original localization experiments on nuScenes, KITTI and SRoad, component ablations, runtime measurements and qualitative analyses in Section 4.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, including benchmark results in Tables 1–3 and ablations in Tables 4–6.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same BEV encoders, cross-modal fusion, perceptual uncertainty-guided association and localization uncertainty-guided registration. The losses and inference procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate fine-grained localization on nuScenes and SRoad with HD maps, and large-scale relocalization on nuScenes, KITTI and SRoad with OSM maps. No additional evaluated domain or scenario is documented.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 1–3 is identical: BEV-Locator, OrienterNet, the ICP-based baseline, MapLocNet and U-BEV appear in the same corresponding comparisons. The added related-work citations introduce no evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The supplied experimental settings are unchanged, including dataset counts, monocular/multi-view configurations, MAE/RMSE and recall metrics. Fine localization retains ±2 m/±2° perturbations and a 120 × 120 m search region; relocalization retains ±30 m/±30° and 128 × 128 m.

E4.justification: Tables 4–6 retain the same association, registration, perceptual uncertainty and pose-prior ablations. Figures 5–6 retain the same qualitative examples and uncertainty/error analysis. The references to unavailable appendix experiments are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither supplied version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The existing per-frame predictive uncertainty reporting remains unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–6 match. For example, multi-view nuScenes HD-map MAEs remain 0.040 m lateral, 0.140 m longitudinal and 0.075° orientation. Runtime remains 28 FPS on V100 and 15 FPS on Orin; qualitative findings also match.

T1.justification: The SE(2) problem formulation and Equations (1)–(14) are unchanged, including association losses, entropy, the joint pose prior and registration fusion. No mathematical assumption, derivation or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about uncertainty-guided association and registration, support for HD/navigation maps, state-of-the-art localization and stable fleet performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of component effectiveness, localization degeneracy and uncertainty/error correlation are unchanged. The conclusion retains the same future-work qualifications concerning limited observations and generalization across datasets and maps.

D1.justification: The supplied encoder, rasterization, search-region, hardware and TensorRT INT8 details are unchanged. No new implementation parameters or code/data access information appear, and the same details remain deferred to an unavailable appendix.

R1.justification: Sections 2.1–2.2 substantially broaden the literature scope to driving world models, generative vision, scene editing, multimodal models, memory and prompting. Nineteen references are added while existing works are retained. The additions also cite U-ViLAR's own published version as related work.

P1.justification: Two passages expand existing related-work subsections. The remaining prose and section sequence are essentially unchanged, so the language and narrative revision is localized.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables retain their designs and captions but reflow around the added text. Figure 4 moves from page 5 to 6, Figure 6 from page 8 to 9, and Tables 4–6 move to the right column of page 8.

improvement.justification: The broader literature offers some additional context, but much of the added generative-vision and multimodal discussion connects to localization only through general assertions. More concretely, Section 2.2 presents U-ViLAR's own publication, reference 27, as related work motivating the paper without clarifying that relationship. This slightly weakens focus and research positioning relative to v1; the technical content and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
